record.paper_title: The puzzle of global Double Field Theory: open problems and the case for a Higher Kaluza-Klein perspective
record.original_question: Can the pre-NQP-manifold approach to Double Field Theory be extended from the currently constructed global examples to general T-dualizable backgrounds, in a way that produces a globally defined pre-NQP manifold for non-trivially fibered spacetimes without having to assume the T-duality correspondence space in advance or duplicate topological data between a gerbe and its dual?

evidence.quote: However there are still some open problems. The only non-trivial global case that was constructed in this framework was, as we saw, on the correspondence space M ×M0 M̃ equipped with the pullback of both the gerbe G and its dual G̃. But, for this construction, the correspondence space of the T-duality is not derived from the pre-NQP manifold theory, but it must be assumed and prepared by using the machinery of topological T-duality.

Moreover, in literature, a globally defined pre-NQP manifold for a non-trivially fibrated spacetime M was proposed only for the case of geometric T-duality. Recently [CWIKW19] applied pre-NQP geometry to the case of DFT on group manifolds. However the extension of this formalism to general T-dualizable backgrounds is not immediate.

artifact.category_tag: Global Double Field Theory and graded geometry
artifact.status_search_result: Existing literature constructs global pre-NQ manifold models for DFT only in restricted settings: on the T-duality correspondence space of principal torus bundles with gerbes (Deser–Sämann, 2019), and on group manifolds (Hassler et al., 2019). These constructions take the correspondence space or group-manifold structure as input. No general construction producing a global pre-NQ manifold canonically from a T-dualizable background without duplicating the gerbe/dual-gerbe topological data has been reported, and surveys list this as an open problem in the globalization of DFT.

status_evidence.title: Pre-NQ Manifolds and Correspondence Spaces: the Nilmanifold Example
status_evidence.snippet: Local construction extended to 3-dimensional nilmanifolds with an abelian gerbe; analogue of a Courant algebroid built over the correspondence space of a T-duality.
status_evidence.claim: Existing global pre-NQ construction relies on the correspondence space being supplied via topological T-duality.

status_evidence.title: DFT in supermanifold formulation and group manifold as background geometry
status_evidence.snippet: Pre-NQ/graded geometric formulation of DFT applied to group manifold backgrounds.
status_evidence.claim: A globally defined pre-NQ formulation exists for the special case of group-manifold backgrounds, but extension to general T-dualizable backgrounds is not immediate.

status_evidence.title: Extended Riemannian geometry III: global Double Field Theory with nilmanifolds
status_evidence.claim: Global DFT models exist for specific geometric T-duality cases on principal torus bundles.
